text:
I was very impressed with the service at this clinic. I had an appointment at 6:00 PM and was treated immediately upon arrival – perfectly on time!

The nurses here are excellent and professional. They were very helpful when I asked to charge my phone.

The restrooms were very clean and smelled wonderful – I was hesitant to use them for fear of making a mess! (However, I wish there were tissues for wiping hands and face at the sink; there were only rolled tissues, which I didn't dare use.)

This time, a male dentist performed the tartar removal. He greeted me before starting and had a very gentle touch, making the treatment go smoothly. He also allowed me to ask questions. He was very professional and mature. Afterward, he summarized my dental health.

*One suggestion, however, is that it would be nice to have a gauze or a thin blanket to cover my mouth during the procedure.*

*This is a personal question, not related to the service. I'm not sure if regular dental clinics have a standard practice of changing instruments after each treatment, such as drills and mouthwash cups. This could be used to advertise the clinic's cleanliness standard.*

This clinic accepts social security insurance. You can also request a full receipt to claim insurance benefits.

Directions:
• If coming from Din Daeng side, the clinic is on the left before Kasikorn Bank.
• If coming from Rama 9 side, go past the Rama 9 intersection, make a U-turn, and look to your left before reaching Kasikorn Bank.

restaurant_name: Khunchanok Dental Clinic (คุณชนก คลินิก ทันตกรรม)
text:
Before having my last wisdom tooth extracted (a prone tooth with a crooked root), I was so afraid of the pain that I endured it for almost twenty years. It grew to the size of my little fingertip 🥹 – huge! The root started causing pain in my cheek, and food particles constantly got stuck, forcing me to carry floss in my bag. Finally, while traveling abroad, I consulted a colleague about where to get it done. They recommended this clinic, saying it was minimally painful and healed quickly. I was skeptical, but I went anyway. They X-rayed the root and overall condition; it was prone to overlapping and the root was crooked.

The doctor was incredibly skilled and quite young. He decided to grind the tooth into pieces and then carefully extracted it with forceps, instead of prying, to avoid further gum trauma and pain. The hole in my gum was exactly the same size as the tooth that was ground away, with a smooth, clean edge. It didn't look bruised or infected like I'd seen in Google posts. The sutures were neatly hidden and perfectly aligned with my jawline. Even after I could open my mouth, the scar looked incredibly well-made.

I was so scared during the surgery, I almost had a meltdown. But after the procedure and the anesthetic wore off, there was a lot of pain for only about half an hour. Applying ice to my cheek quickly relieved the pain, and then there was no more pain at all. There was just a slight tightness from the stitches. Touching the wound with my tongue only caused a little ache. It didn't hurt at all; it was completely indifferent unless touched, which surprised me. This was a real wisdom tooth extraction! The only thing to watch out for is food particles getting into the tooth cavity. You have to either remove them or, like I did, use a children's syringe to inject saline into the cavity, and the food particles come out. It was so much fun! 🤣🥹 The wound healed quickly, in less than two weeks.

The extraction was also very easy, just a smooth, slippery motion. I had eight more teeth filled right away. The dentist said these fillings would last almost two more years.

I give this place a perfect ten out of ten. It was amazing!

text:
Dr. Chidchanok is an amazing orthodontist! I found her through a social media review. After receiving treatment, I found her to be truly skilled and caring. I was impressed from the consultation. I had consulted with 7-8 other orthodontists, and none of them had a treatment plan like Dr. Chidchanok's. Some said traditional braces weren't possible and only Brius or clear aligners were suitable. But Dr. Chidchanok suggested that traditional braces were possible for my case because of her excellent treatment planning skills. Importantly, she wasn't pushy at all. I felt like I saw a ray of hope when I started treatment with her. The price wasn't exorbitant at all; it was even lower than I expected, considering she's a specialist in orthodontics. I thought it would be very expensive, but it wasn't. She gave excellent advice, explained everything thoroughly, was gentle, patient, spoke kindly, answered all my questions in detail and directly, leaving no room for lingering doubts. She was incredibly respectful of her patients; she even apologized for being a few minutes late, something I've never experienced before. I'm so glad I found her. Thank you to the reviewer for sharing this information!

If you're driving, convenient parking is available. I recommend parking at Fortune Town and walking over. It's not far and you don't need to cross the street.

***Update after 1 year of orthodontic treatment: My teeth are much better and much faster than before! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️***

After 1 year, my teeth are so well-aligned that I'm already very happy. The improvement is incredible. My previous orthodontic treatment took 4 years, and my teeth didn't progress as much as they did after just one year with this doctor.

Regarding my scissor bite (3 pairs of teeth), I consulted with 10 clinics, and 8 said my case was very difficult and metal braces weren't possible. They said even if I did get metal braces, they weren't sure what the outcome would be, and it would likely take up to 8 years. They only recommended clear aligners or Brius. Only 2 clinics said metal braces were possible: a professor at Chulalongkorn University and Dr. Chidchanok at this clinic. I chose her because she explained the treatment plan very clearly, offered alternative treatment options, and answered all my questions from the first day of treatment until a year later. She's still exactly the same!

My teeth are aligning very quickly. Other clinics said this problem was irresolvable or would take many years to fix (Fact: my previous treatment took 4 years, and my crooked teeth were still crooked). (Because the scissors bite problem couldn't be fixed at all) But the doctor managed to fix it within a year. My teeth are now perfectly aligned, and I can smile confidently. It might not be completely fixed yet, but the alignment of my teeth is significantly improved.

I've made her my go-to dentist. I've recommended her to everyone I know, telling them to always consult Dr. Chidchanok first! You'll get a great opinion and she won't be pushy. Thank you for finding her, Dr. Chidchanok. It's one of the luckiest things in my life to have met such a good doctor. 🙏
